It is completely understandable to feel pressure about your body and want to change how you look, especially with so many unrealistic standards out there. However, trying to lose weight "fast" can be very dangerous, particularly for a growing body. Rapid weight loss methods can lead to serious health complications and negatively impact your physical and mental development. 

Instead of focusing on getting skinny quickly, it is much safer to focus on overall well-being and feeling strong. Because you are underage, the best and most accessible step is to talk to a trusted adult, like a parent, school counselor, or a doctor. A healthcare professional can help you understand what a healthy body looks like for your specific age and growth stage, and they can support you in building safe, balanced habits that nourish your body rather than harm it.
